codebook.definition: Threat of punishment contingent on a named actor's behavior.
codebook.inclusion_rule: Explicit if/unless/otherwise structure or promised retaliation naming target.

codebook.definition: Stated date, time window or duration attached to action.
codebook.inclusion_rule: Any concrete deadline, effective date, pause length or schedule.

codebook.definition: Offer, pause, suspension, ceasefire or exemption extended or announced.
codebook.inclusion_rule: Post announces de-escalation, concession or openness to negotiate.

codebook.definition: Claim of military action or success against Iran or others.
codebook.inclusion_rule: Reports strikes, destruction, kills, or enemy capability gone.

codebook.definition: Claim that an agreement, concession or progress exists.
codebook.inclusion_rule: States counterparty agreed, deal done/close, talks productive; usually unverifiable in-post.

codebook.definition: Quantified or verifiable specifics: figures, named officials, places, ships.
codebook.inclusion_rule: Contains numbers, percentages, named individuals or identifiable items.

codebook.definition: Attack on media, analysts, or political critics, or rebuttal of reports.
codebook.inclusion_rule: Names or labels press/opponents as false or incompetent.

codebook.definition: Favorable contrast with Obama/Biden/JCPOA or past presidents.
codebook.inclusion_rule: Explicit comparison to earlier administrations or deals.
Words like subject to, if, hopefully, probably, until finalized.

codebook.definition: Other actors cited as requesters, mediators, allies or sources.
codebook.inclusion_rule: Names a third country, leader or institution that shapes action.

codebook.definition: Repost or link to others' article or statement without original assertion.
codebook.inclusion_rule: Post is mainly a URL or RT of media or praise from others.

codebook.definition: Claims about Strait of Hormuz, blockade, shipping or oil flow.
codebook.inclusion_rule: Mentions strait status, blockade, mines, tolls, oil volumes or prices.

codebook.definition: Tariff, sanction or trade-policy action or threat.
codebook.inclusion_rule: Concrete tariff, duty, export control, investigation or trade deal.

codebook.definition: Insults, boasts, hyperbole, triumphal or emotive language.
Statement that contradicts, revokes or walks back an earlier position.
codebook.inclusion_rule: Cancels, resumes, or reverses a prior stated stance or schedule.

themes.description: Threats paired with a stated off-switch or pause, typically tied to Hormuz opening, deal signing, or a tariff removal.
Pauses, ceasefires and cancellations justified by third-party requests and framed as subject to finalization, often later superseded.
Assertions that counterparties conceded or that adversaries are destroyed, sometimes denied or contradicted elsewhere.

themes.theme: Specificity ranges from dated tariff orders to vague boasts
themes.description: Tariff posts carry rates and effective dates; military and deal posts mix precise figures with sweeping claims.

themes.theme: Credibility defense against media, critics and prior deals
themes.description: Rebuts press and opponents and frames the current deal against the Obama JCPOA.
Reposts and links of favorable outside commentary, repeated across posts.
